metadata.description: Plugin marketplace for the Genius/Atom application stack

plugins.name: atom-backend
plugins.description: Test conventions and commands for .NET solutions built on the Genius.Atom framework — xUnit v3, AutoFixture + FakeItEasy, Atom TestingUtil (FakeDateTime, FakeLogger, BaseRepositoryTests), EF Core repository tests, migrate-on-startup schema guards, and WebApplicationFactory integration tests over in-memory SQLite. Reads the app's own solution map from its CLAUDE.md.

plugins.name: atom-frontend
plugins.description: Conventions for React SPAs built on the private @hwndmaster/atom-* packages — Redux Toolkit + redux-saga slice layout, PrimeReact, Vite, Vitest with SagaRunner and fakeAxios, NSwag-generated API clients, and the ESLint import boundaries that keep UI out of api/. Reads the app's own slice inventory and ports from its CLAUDE.md.

plugins.name: atom-devops
plugins.description: The build, publish and CI plumbing every Genius/Atom app repo shares, kept as versioned templates instead of copies. sync-toolchain renders them into a repo and reports drift; docker-publish drives the ghcr.io publish and package-cleanup flow.
